notes.title: Cozyrama demo update 0.2
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/fbe605b13a2636dd7279f45a50b209297693b8a5.png"]

In this update:

- Ability to change the shape of the diorama

- Screenshot tool fixes

- Buttons in the radial menu no longer appear pressed

- Water detection is now much more accurate (placing decorations near water should work fine!)

- Performance improvements

- Duplication bug fixed

- Camera limits improved

- Every color icon now matches its color

- Fox and squirrel can no longer drown (lily pads now appear under their feet)

- Tools on controller now have sounds

- Small decorations no longer swing wildly

- Deleting decorations with the Del key now has a sound

- Added European French and European Spanish

- Added more keyboard shortcuts to make playing on a touchpad easier (you can scale and rotate decorations with the arrow keys)

- New scenes now start empty, with no grass and no road

- Added snakes!

Thanks for trying out the demo! 🩷

notes.title: Cozyrama demo update 0.1
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Fixed rooster swim animation (he is no longer moonwalking!)

- Carpet no longer buries itself under paths

- You can now add spaces in diorama names

- Swing no longer causes issues

- Added the ability to move the camera up and down! (Up/Down arrows on keyboard, L1/R1 on gamepad)

- Added more navigation hints to make camera control easier

- A few minor bug fixes

- Changed game icon to match the steam one

notes.title: Colors, Water and Lights ☀️
notes.content:
🌿 Hi folks! 🌿
First of all, thank you for your patience since our last update and the fantastic number of sign-ups for the upcoming playtests! You exceeded our wildest expectations! 💚



Today, we’re diving into significant updates that will make our game shine even brighter: Lighting and Water! ✨


💡 Lighting: More Real, More Beautiful
We’ve changed our lighting system to help the game feel more natural and immersive.

We've switched from Gamma to Linear color space, which means light now behaves more like it does in the real world. Shadows are deeper, sunlight wraps around objects more softly, and colors blend more organically.

To top it off, we've upgraded to ACES tone mapping, making everything feel more cinematic. Soft sunsets, glowing windows, and warm contrasts make you want to stay in every moment. Plus, anti-aliasing removes jagged edges, leaving a smoother finish and cleaner visuals worldwide. It’s all small changes, but together, they make a big difference in how everything looks and feels!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/bf0baf2e34c2bfff6d3802e3ac9243fc9849ec00.gif"]
💧 Water: Let’s make a splash!
We’ve also examined water in Cozyrama 🔎👀. No longer just a pretty background. Water became an interactive part of the world. It's clearer, deeper, and hugs the edges of the terrain more naturally, bringing an extra layer of life to the environment. Even better, water can now be colored in any way imaginable. Whether shimmering turquoise pools or soft lavender streams, the perfect watery scene is just a brushstroke away.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/155b5d4274e01ccbb5064dbe64ebf88d06265ba7.gif"]
📸 Before & After Magic
We've prepared some side-by-side GIFS to show you the difference these updates make. Check them out below and see how the new lighting and water changes have transformed the game! 😮

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/9e51749381400c4439c86d59b434d9e3259f6516.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/2197ddee87a6b33a338f8bbfab8098424e91102c.gif"]


Last but not least, we have a quick update for you! 👀
During the pre-production phase, we realized that the game would be even better if we focused more on decorating the charming environments rather than just the tree itself. So, we’ve decided to change the game’s name to reflect better what it's truly about...🥁Say hello to COZYRAMA! 🥁



That’s it for today! While we’re still hard at work on the game, we’re excited to share that playtests are just around the corner, so stay tuned for more details!

- Cozyrama Team

notes.title: Devlog #2: Cozy Combos 🍃🦔
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/a855bb60991eacebbeaec81bdbce26a27efe3306.gif🍃 Hi folks! 🍃

First of all, a huge thank you for the warm reception of Your Tree! 🌳💚  
Seeing your excitement really warms our hearts, and we can’t wait to share more of our game with you.

Today, we’d like to tell you about something we’ve been working on recently: Cozy Combos! ✨

🍂 What are Cozy Combos? 🍂

From the beginning, we wanted Your Tree to be more than just a game about decorating a tree—we wanted it to be a fun and curious experience.

In Your Tree, decorations aren’t just static items; they can interact with each other in unexpected ways! Think of it as a hidden layer of unique connections within the game, waiting to be discovered.

For example:


🦔 A little hedgehog wearing a flower crown? The cutest forest fashion! (above)
🎃 Pumpkins as scarecrow’s face — now that’s spooky fun!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/bb56fd0c8539218fdb5cfe8b10656f5984ab6c9c.gif
🍲 A bubbling cauldron filled with delicious pumpkin soup sets the perfect autumn mood!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/ff4bb72a783d7c00d9a2c6e0ce93ef1be3cd13ff.gif
🎨 An easel showcasing different paintings based on the items — your tiny art gallery! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/417a4f67ce3743b650cadbecc8b33c7f59b99492.gif


And that’s just the beginning — there are many more Cozy Combos to uncover!

But we don’t want to spoil all the surprises... The joy of Your Tree is in experimenting with it yourself!

What other Cozy Combos would you like to see?

And, of course, don’t forget to add Your Tree to your wishlist on Steam! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133020/Your_Tree/

- Sandwich Games 🥪

notes.title: 🌳 Your Tree - Our First Announcement!🌳
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]🌲 Let's introduce you to... Your Tree!

Hi folks! 👋

My name is Kuba, and I’d like to tell you today about our passion project, Your Tree.🌳
It's a game we've been working on over the past few months, and we're ready to show it to you ːsteamhappyː 

Your Tree is a cosy, relaxing game about growing trees. You choose every detail, such as trunks and leaves, change the tree's colours, and decide on ornaments around the tree.

Let's dive in! ːbessie_loveː

Here you can see how the game looked like in the very early stage:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/07ae26eb05efc05e99958bd6bc065dcb15429160.gif



And sometime later: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/71bcd23f6f8968f278691fb5d52f0c607ec714ab.gif



Until one of the most recent updates: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45330953/576f648a696b6db730a5c6501bbe4c7e1ba98774.png


[hr][/hr]Your Tree is a project we’ve been working on after hours whenever we find some free time, so please forgive us for any unpolished bits and pieces!

We’re still in early development, and we’d love to hear your ideas for what could be added to the game. We have plenty of ideas, but we strongly believe in community-driven development, and we want to build this game with your ideas!


In the meantime, if you like what we have worked on, feel free to add the game to your wishlist. It will help us a lot! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133020/Your_Tree/

- Sandwich Games 🥪
